scientific.integrity: The rank of the invariant coefficient bundle is reconstructed from the full stable-isotypic commutant and its single trace equation. Riemann--Roch computes the deformation-complex index, while Cao's Lemma 5.5 supplies the endpoint dimensions. The maximizing non-stable type is established by an elementary convexity argument; finite enumeration is only a stress test.
limitations: Only Cao's degree-zero determinant-trivialized trace-free SL_r joint moduli problem is treated.
The result gives dimensions, not transverse singularity types, closure relations, or counts of connected strata.
The extremal statement concerns numerical orbit types and does not assert uniqueness of a connected component.

title: Exact dimensions of joint Higgs orbit-type strata
